# Helix

Helix is an applied LLM / data-science lab: evaluation harnesses,
retrieval pipelines, a feature store and fine-tuning. Four repos share
one domain model — eval budgets, hybrid retrieval and feature lineage
are the interesting part.

## Repos
- `helix/evalkit`   — eval harness, token budgets, graders (start here)
- `helix/retriever` — hybrid BM25 + embedding search
- `helix/features`  — online feature store and lineage
- `helix/finetune`  — LoRA / QLoRA adapter training
